purpose: Distinguish source programmes that genuinely contain repeated, comparable ecological interaction sampling from opportunistic occurrence/specimen/literature aggregation before any interaction-turnover response is computed.
candidate_rule: Only sourceNamespace x interactionTypeId systems that pass the frozen v0.4 structural support gate may enter. No failing system can be rescued here.

PASS_REPLICATED_ECOLOGICAL_NETWORK: A public source description or methods section explicitly defines biological interaction sampling at identifiable sites/localities and dates or sampling periods.
The source records represent observed interactions collected under a repeatable sampling design, not merely independent occurrence/specimen records.
At least five v0.4-supported sampling strata can be mapped to comparable site/time units using metadata retained in GloBI.
At least ten supported focal taxa recur across at least two such comparable units.
The focal-to-partner relation represented by the frozen GloBI interaction type is biologically interpretable without reversing source and target roles after support is known.
HOLD_SOURCE_UNIT_NOT_RECONSTRUCTABLE: The underlying study is ecological, but GloBI does not retain enough event/site metadata to reconstruct comparable network units without guessing or outcome-informed clustering.
EXCLUDE_OPPORTUNISTIC_AGGREGATION: The source is primarily an occurrence, specimen, citizen-science, taxonomic, literature-mined, or heterogeneous compilation in which each row is not part of a common interaction survey unit.
Geographic coordinates are observation locations but do not define replicated networks with comparable sampling effort/opportunity.
EXCLUDE_SEMANTIC_AMBIGUITY: The interaction relation or focal/partner orientation cannot be mapped to one frozen biological interaction family from source documentation.
Source documentation is unavailable or insufficient to distinguish sampled interaction networks from aggregated records.

network_unit_priority: Use a source-native sampling-event/network identifier when GloBI retains one and the source documents its meaning.
Otherwise use documented localityId plus the documented sampling period.
Otherwise use exact latitude/longitude plus the finest eventDate resolution that the source protocol declares comparable.
Never round coordinates, cluster observations, widen time windows, or merge sites to make a source pass.

sampling_effort_rule.requirement: Before turnover is opened, document whether effort is comparable, explicitly effort-standardized, or unavailable for each passing namespace.
sampling_effort_rule.if_effort_unavailable: The namespace cannot enter the primary rewiring analysis; it may be retained only as a labelled sensitivity/validation source if a frozen detection-robust estimator is later justified independently.
sampling_effort_rule.reason: Apparent rewiring must not be created by changing observation effort.

interaction_family_rule.other_labels: HOLD unless their biological meaning can be assigned from source documentation without inspecting turnover results
interaction_family_rule.multiple_interaction_types_per_namespace: do not create independent replicates; sourceNamespace remains the independence cluster

gate.pass: At least 12 independent sourceNamespaces contain one or more structurally supported systems adjudicated PASS_REPLICATED_ECOLOGICAL_NETWORK with reconstructable units and acceptable effort semantics.
gate.hold: Fewer than 12 independent sourceNamespaces pass. Stop the primary joint interaction arm; do not lower the threshold and do not introduce a third source.

next_gate_if_pass: Freeze exact network-unit construction and phylogeny coverage for each passing sourceNamespace x interaction family, then run observed-geometry informativeness simulations before any biological turnover effect.
